environment: Windows desktop Chromium in-app browser; 390 × 844 CSS-pixel emulation, not a physical phone

automatedTests.compatibility: Frozen v0.7.0–v0.10.0 conversions; schemas 1–10; storage keys unchanged
automatedTests.scope: Styles, densities, scales, ranges, variants, 19 chords, no-common-tone fallback, preservation, 25 transpositions, cancellation, stereo PCM comparison, 32-bar WAV and independent MP3 decoding

browser.library: 13 existing works retained; one newly saved melody work, total 14
browser.previewPurity: Shared snapshot before and after original/candidate audition, rapid switching, stop and close is identical
browser.variant: Next changes candidate 1 to 2 and changes bar summaries; replay keeps candidate fixed
browser.compose: Only melody bars 1–4 change; full backing and melody outside section preserved by decoded share comparison
browser.answer: Prefix bars 1–2 including durations and velocities exactly retained; backing preserved
browser.repitch: Density disabled; all onset/rest positions, durations and velocities retained while pitches change
browser.confirmation: Cancel keeps workshop open; confirm applies; undo restores exact original share and redo exact generated share
browser.empty: Answer/repitch reject empty source; compose offers scale-only candidate and no-chord warning
browser.escape: Esc closes workshop during audition and main playback stays stopped
browser.persistence: Generated work expanded by repetition to 32 bars, saved and reloaded; share reopens identical snapshot
browser.exports: 32-bar MP3 and WAV generation completed with expected filenames; cancel reports work retained

responsive.verticalScrolling: Apply below initial fold; locator scrolls to it successfully, opens overwrite prompt, and cancel returns to workshop

limits: Global timbres, volume, tempo and tonality
